N Engl J Med 1996; 335: 1081–90. HIV infection prophylaxis. Antiretroviral drugs are used for chemoprophylaxis after occupational and non-occupational ex- posure to HIV infection. Zidovudine is commonly used with oth- er antiretroviral drugs after exposure with a risk of infection (see p.858). Zidovudine has been shown to be of value in reducing vertical transmission. For further information on the use of zidovudine in preventing HIV transmission from mother to child, see HIV In- fection Prophylaxis, p.858. Preparations USP 31: Zidovudine Capsules; Zidovudine Injection; Zidovudine Oral So- lution; Zidovudine Tablets.
